rationale: Final policy: retain explicit bounded tuning and caller-selected schedules. Ordinary plan_cuda uses BASELINE_SCHEDULE and does not load historical tuning winners. Qualified tuning returns a concrete plan/artifact and complete evidence for its exact workload, source and device; that is not a global automatic dispatcher. Positive retained layout/schedule results remain valid on their original identities. Views, fusion, recomputation, donation and layout selection are not enabled globally; direct GEMM and existing compiler legality transformations retain their separately qualified defaults.
revisit_condition: Reopen automatic winner loading only for a complete production consumer that binds source/device/workload/artifact identity, charges preparation and cache costs, and deterministically retains the baseline on every miss or stale receipt. Keep explicit tuning available independently.
